source_policy: 55886 gives高手以上, differing room levels and summons that expire. All144variants,36levels,432spawns,stats,rewards and schedules are local design, not adoption of198official monster records; never infer source identity from item name.

authoring_rules.stats: L=explicit room level;HP=(200+20L)*3 ordinary or*5 summoned; attack[10+L,20+2L],defense3L,accuracy5L,evasion2L
authoring_rules.rewards: explicit pinned等级经验 rows XP/practice*3 ordinary,*12 summoned; silver5L/20L, ascension1500/6000 subject14qualification. Independent explicit profile, never multiply level reward again
authoring_rules.tier: summoned reward*12 is local choice, not boss classification or immunity
authoring_rules.empty_random_loot: intentional absence of ordinary item trials; fortune bonus has no target here; personal quest tokens separate

ai.movement_policy: walk navigation paths, no teleport through obstacles or to home
ai.target: connected living hostile outside8m safe zone; shortest reachable distance then stable ID, revalidate each decision
ai.safe_zone: no hostile spawn/entry; player entering loses target; monster returns by path
ai.return: only at valid home restore fullHP without rewards; no reward on leash/despawn

ordinary_lifecycle.initial: explicit new world creates ordinary slots alive/full generation0; visiting/reloading never initializes again
ordinary_lifecycle.death: unique payout receipt then waiting7200, no simultaneous alive copy
ordinary_lifecycle.blocked_spawn: at zero wait if connected living player within5m, occupied capsule or invalid navigation; no replacement coordinates
ordinary_lifecycle.generation: increment only when actual respawn commits; death key world/spawn/generation
ordinary_lifecycle.offscreen: world ticks waits even without viewer; no attack without simulated target; whole world pause/offline freezes

summon_schedule.schedule: each30simulation minutes first10minutes;4slots/room,3breath producers and1trophy producer
summon_schedule.initial: step0 already open; new world may spawn once per slot after collision checks
summon_schedule.late_load: reconcile saved cycle/state, never a second batch on room loading
summon_schedule.spawn: each slot once/cycle;5m player/collision/navigation exclusion waits only within window, no alternative location
summon_schedule.death: killed slot spent until next cycle; no ordinary respawn
summon_schedule.expiry: phase36000 remove live summons before new actions/death events; no kill/XP/drop/task credit; old projectiles cannot settle on removed actor
summon_schedule.race: earlier committed kill normal; same-step expiry has priority; death receipt once
summon_schedule.new_cycle: skip unobserved expired cycles without backlog; generation keyed by actual cycle

persistence.load: validate all432slots/kind/monster/world identity,legal HP/position/timers/cycle and death receipts; missing new fields reject, never heal/reset from reload/reconnect
persistence.reconcile: same-world monotone clock; expire/reconcile before actions; no wall-time catch-up or despawn rewards
persistence.combat: save23accepted-action snapshots/cooldowns/status/death settlement via05, never heal or reset on load; HP has single world owner
persistence.legacy: known1..4 import creates fresh spawn state only for explicitly new target world, joining existing world retains host state
persistence.lan: host alone commits damage/death/token/public bag/respawn; clients cannot assert fresh cycle/generation
